name: io.github.albertescoda/tennis-control
title: Tennis Control
description: Public tennis tournament calendar: 50+ countries, Tennis Europe, ITF Juniors and pro tours.

tools.name: search_tournaments
tools.description: Search the public tennis tournament calendar of Tennis Control (www.tenniscontrol.es): national federations of 50+ countries, Tennis Europe, ITF Juniors, ATF, COSAT, COTECC, and professional tours (ATP, Challenger, WTA, ITF). Filter by country, region, category, circuit, dates, text or open registration. Returns dates, venue, categories, entry deadline and the official link where entries are made (Tennis Control never handles entries). Only tournaments ending today or later unless 'from' is given.

country.description: Country: name (Spanish or English) or code, e.g. 'España', 'Italy', 'FR', 'GER', 'AD'

region.description: Region or province, e.g. 'Cataluña', 'Madrid', 'Lombardia'. For Spain, autonomous communities

category.description: Age category: U10, U12, U14, U16, JR (U18), ABS (open/adults), or veterans V30…V80 ('V' = any veterans). Spanish names accepted (alevín, infantil, cadete, júnior, absoluto)

circuit.description: Circuit code or name: te (Tennis Europe), itf (ITF Juniors), atf, cosat, cotecc, atp, chal, wta, wta125, itfp, isq (Spain iSQUAD), fat (Andorra), fitp, fft, dtb… Use list_circuits

from.description: Start of date range (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today

text.description: Free text in name, venue or notes (e.g. a city or club)

open_entries.description: Only tournaments whose entry deadline has not passed yet

tools.name: get_tournament
tools.description: Full public details of one tournament by its id (from search_tournaments): dates, venue, categories, entry and withdrawal deadlines, entry rule and official link.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Countries covered by the Tennis Control calendar, with code, name and number of upcoming tournaments.

tools.name: list_circuits
tools.description: Circuits (federations, international and professional tours) and age categories available, with number of upcoming tournaments.
